material.locator: IFLA-UNESCO Public Library Manifesto 2022, “Missions of the Public Library”, p. 2, preservation/access of local and Indigenous data, knowledge and heritage; digitised and born-digital material.
material.description: The Manifesto explicitly identifies preservation and access to local and Indigenous knowledge, oral tradition and digitised/born-digital cultural material as public-library missions. It does not prescribe a specific digital preservation architecture.
